Reverse a number.

Supplied answer
num = int(input("Enter a number: "))
original = num
reverse = 0
while num > 0:
    digit = num % 10
    reverse = reverse * 10 + digit
    num //= 10
print(f"Original = {original}, Reversed = {reverse}")
Note: reverse * 10 + digit shifts the existing digits left and adds the new one.
